title: Gemini is officially lobotomized and NanoBanana's results have never been worse, any good equivalents to jump ship to?
author: Fluid-Tap5115
selftext:
Had been creating a lot of assets with nanobanana and the latest wave of lobotomy that Nano Banan has recieved has absolutely tanked the results I have been getting 

My renders have been genuinely AWFUL, an absolute drop in quality, and it is so apparent its not even up for discussion 

Uptil now I have been using Gemini pro, but would love to see what equivalent alternatives would be available that still retain that same Nano Banana image render quality

Lmk

comments.author: Microtom_
comments.body: Not seeing any differences on AI studio, although they reduced free access by half. Still decent for being free.

comments.author: op_app_pewer
comments.body:
Feel free to try the free tier on dreamforge.AI and send some feedback

Imo uses the best image and video models for assets and spritesheets

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: is it only for characters? Asked buildings from it, it generated characters.

replies.author: op_app_pewer
replies.body:
Ah, need to fix onboarding flow!
You can generate houses etc if you open the asset studio once that is done.

(Continuing thread before new commercial rule, and trying not to spam, just be helpful^^)

comments.author: nathanielx9
comments.body: It still produces images just fine for me

comments.author: EinArchitekt
comments.body: Hitting limits faster in pro, thats true, quality still the same it seems like

comments.author: EmotionalFan5429
comments.body: Nano Banana Pro gives me worse images then basic Nano Banana, that is not perfect in the first place. It's Ok for free. though. And Nano Banana can add stylized text to images in my native language.

comments.author: ArialBear
comments.body: what are you trying to make with nanobanana that give you bad results?

comments.author: Gadgetsjon
comments.body: I'm experiencing the same issue. It's dead. Need to find something else. I ended up with Gemini because the same thing happened to Chat GPT, but now that's improved and Nano Banana is producing unusable results. Not even good enough for reference. It's so bad.
